selection.summary: Fixes #1971 in pkg/cmd/repo/view/view.go: `gh repo view .` now resolves the base repo instead of treating "." as a repo name (RepoArg == "" || "." branch), and falls back to a local README (README.md/markdown/mdown/mkdown/README) via new localReadme() helper when the remote README lookup returns NotFoundError. Added ioutil/os imports. Relevant base evidence: view.go control flow (h0/h9/h10/h13/h14) and http.go RepositoryReadme NotFoundError semantics (h1/h2).
